question: Hewlett Packard Enterprise founded location
markdown:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) was founded on November 1, 2015, following the split of the original Hewlett-Packard Company, which was started in 1939 in a Palo Alto garage. HPE is headquartered in Spring, Texas, and operates as a global edge-to-cloud platform as-a-service company.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) traces its foundational roots to a garage in Palo Alto, California, where Bill Hewlett and Dave Packard started the original Hewlett-Packard company in 1939.
The famous garage is at 367 Addison Avenue in Palo Alto, California.
HPE was officially created on November 1, 2015, following the split of the original Hewlett-Packard Company.
HPE's current headquarters is in Spring, Texas, relocated there in 2022.
HPE is an American IT multinational based in Spring, TX.
HPE is the global edge-to-cloud platform as-a-service company.
